scope: bounded explicit discrete constant-acceleration trajectory and independent closed-form differential numerical checks; no arbitrary physics/HPC claim; host RCL-owned compilation, generic RBC instructions/authority/transaction decisions on actual AMD FP64 OpenCL GPU, host hashes device-produced snapshots; one serial work item, no parallel throughput, CPU VM fallback, provider calls, typed records, sessions or whole-family claim

host hashes typed device-produced snapshots and transaction continuity

trials.intent: Each explicit step advances position by the old velocity, then adds acceleration to velocity, and appends the new position to the trajectory.
The closed-form position must match explicit integration where position is advanced with old velocity before acceleration changes that velocity.
The final velocity after a given number of constant-acceleration discrete steps must match the explicit step integrator, including zero steps.
